Thank you for applying!

Dear {{ object.partner_name or 'Candidate' }},

We have received your application for the position of {{ object.job_id.name }} at {{ object.company_id.name }}.

Our HR team will review your application and get back to you shortly. You can track your application status at any time using the link below:

Track My Application

Best regards,
{{ object.company_id.name }} HR Team

Application Update

Dear {{ object.partner_name or 'Candidate' }},

Your application for {{ object.job_id.name }} has moved to a new stage: {{ object.stage_id.name }}.

View your application status →

Best regards,
{{ object.company_id.name }} HR Team

🎉 Congratulations! You've received a job offer!

Dear {{ object.partner_name }},

We are pleased to offer you the position of {{ object.job_id.name }} at {{ object.company_id.name }}.

{% if object.offer_salary %}

Offered Salary: {{ object.currency_id.symbol }}{{ '{:,.0f}'.format(object.offer_salary) }}

{% endif %} {% if object.offer_joining_date %}

Proposed Start Date: {{ object.offer_joining_date.strftime('%d %B %Y') }}

{% endif %} {% if object.offer_expiry_date %}

Offer Valid Until: {{ object.offer_expiry_date.strftime('%d %B %Y') }}

{% endif %}

Accept or Decline Offer

We look forward to welcoming you to the team!

Best regards,
{{ object.company_id.name }} HR Team
Welcome to {{ object.employee_id.company_id.name }}! Your onboarding starts today

Welcome to the team, {{ object.employee_id.name }}! 🎉

We're thrilled to have you on board as our new {{ object.job_id.name }}.

Your onboarding plan has been set up with {{ object.task_count }} tasks to help you settle in smoothly.

{% if object.buddy_id %}

Your Onboarding Buddy is {{ object.buddy_id.name }}. Don't hesitate to reach out to them for any questions!

{% endif %}

Your first week checklist includes:

    {% for task in object.task_ids[:5] %}
  • {{ task.name }} (due: {{ task.due_date }})
    • {% endfor %}

Best regards,
{{ object.employee_id.company_id.name }} HR Team
